relations.evidence: The API Gateway comprises several key components that work together to manage incoming API traffic effectively.
These components include: - Rate Limiter: Controls the frequency of requests from clients to prevent abuse and ensure fair resource distribution.
These components include: - WAF (Web Application Firewall): Provides protection against common web vulnerabilities by filtering and monitoring HTTP traffic between the API Gateway and clients.
These components include: - TLS Terminator: Handles SSL/TLS termination, ensuring secure communication between clients and the API Gateway.
